title: Built-in Navigation Accuracy and Usability
summary: Feedback centers on the G70’s built-in navigation, with negative reviews citing inaccurate mapping, limited routing options, and poor system usability, while many other mentions are too brief or ambiguous to classify.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe outdated or inaccurate maps, wrong or unclear routing behavior, missing route-selection options, and broad frustration with the built-in navigation system.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention navigation praise, improvement ideas, freezing, spinning startup, or vague references to navigation without enough detail to classify sentiment confidently.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are short, truncated, or vague, which limits confidence in sentiment classification and issue detail.
The undetermined set includes both favorable and unfavorable cues, so it should not be treated as neutral or combined with clearly negative feedback.
Examples are drawn from a stratified sample and do not represent the prevalence of navigation problems in the broader vehicle population.
Some negative fragments are generic complaints about the navigation system and do not specify the exact failure mode.
